blocks.heading: Labels while you type
blocks.body:
**Hints** are labels in Author that show the name of the piece you are in (step, command, result) while you type.

You may toggle **Hints**, **Inline actions**, and **Full tags**. You may not ship a private Author look that only your login can see.

**Enter** opens a list of next legal pieces. The parent piece decides the list. If a toolbar button is grey, this kind of page does not allow that thing in that spot.

Outline is the tree. Click to jump.

blocks.heading: Do the work
blocks.body:
You just met the idea. Now do the lab: Hints on.

This lab can fail. Fail when: You added a private Author look as the lab, or you never opened the Enter list, or Hints stayed off.

Expected: Hints on. Three labels listed. Enter used for the list. Framework note written. No private look.

blocks.lead: Walk the cards below, in order, to Hints on.
blocks.intro: How to Hints on. Walk the cards in order. Tick them in the lab after you actually do them.

steps.title: Hints on
steps.body: This is the whole move. The next cards are the steps, in order.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: In Author, find the Styles dropdown (default / Hints / Inline actions / Full tags :  verify labels).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: Turn on Hints. Write three hint labels you see on a how-to (for example cmd, info, result).

image.alt: Default Oxygen XML Editor window with menus, side views, and the empty editor in the middle
image.caption: The first Oxygen window. Menus at the top, helper views at the sides, empty editor in the middle.
image.credit: Oxygen XML Editor User Guide, Syncro Soft

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: Place the caret in the steps. Press Enter. The list should offer a step, not a free paragraph at all costs.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.body: Open Outline. Click result to jump. Click cmd to jump.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.body: Do not add a private look in Options to make headings a new color. If you already did, remove it and write that you did.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.body: Write oxygen-bootcamp-work/week5/framework-note.txt: a framework packages the page rules, the look, the toolbar, and the templates. I may turn on Hints. I do not ship a private look.

blocks.q: A framework packages page rules, look, toolbars, and templates. Who owns that package on a team desk?
options: The lead, shared with the install
Whoever last changed the heading color
blocks.why: You may turn on Hints. You do not each invent a private look.

blocks.lead: Answer with words from today only.
blocks.q: Enter in Author opens a list of next pieces. You press Enter twice to ‘make space’. What goes wrong?
options: Nothing :  like a normal word processor
You may insert extra pieces this kind of page did not ask for
Oxygen converts the file to a notepad file
blocks.why: Enter is a smart insert. Space is not a design tool.
